purpose: Compare causal_cuda and reference_cuda on the same zero-preparation sham organism and explicit SET/ADD event owner before interpreting long behavior.
immutable_model: Same checkpoint, body, W, event representation and biological parameters in both arms; only the cell engine differs.
comparison: Scientific state components, body and pending sensors; exact clocks/event counts and all finite. Continuous absolute limit 1e-4; report field maxima even on failure.
limitation: Twenty milliseconds do not certify a 400-ms odor response. A failed reference run or tolerance failure blocks biological admission and is not fixed by loosening tolerance.
